in_arabic.name: خيرية
in_arabic.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic word 'khayr' which means 'good' or 'blessing'. The feminine form of this word is 'khayriyyah', which means 'The one who is good' or 'The one who does good'. This name is suitable for a baby girl who is expected to grow up to be a virtuous and benevolent individual.

in_pashto.name: خيريه
